recommendation.selection_rationale: Batch 11 provides an intermediate-concentration anchor between the dilute and plateau regimes, with both an immediate pH-meter reading and a final assay after 600 seconds. Its non-clipped intermediate responses help constrain effective acidity and distinguish a universally flat response from concentration dependence. This is an evidentiary choice, not an optimization claim.
